reason: Plan Phase 5. r59's shade placement, colour, transform and sampler are accepted (Eden run of 2026-11-01). r60 ran the same day and was rejected: 'still not changed', 'r59 and r60 both failed to shown worn blade for orange or red color sharpness' (runs/r60-eden-2026-11-01.txt sha256 128906c530982e01e997f9d0457d4757af578111a331c9f265a2f4323eef711a, 73 fill lines all shade_tex=0.0 280.0 88.0 304.0). r61 (52be4a7) is WITHDRAWN: packaged, never run, do not ship; its premise - the mask's authored pair squeezing the copy's 88 columns into the box, like r58's - is refuted, because a scissor clips at 1:1 and the orange crops show no spiral inside the dark part at half sharpness. The real cause is the drawn quad's UV cache: the draw slot main+0xa4fc9c calls main+0xa4feb4, which reads +0x10c..+0x118 and the colours at +0xa4 only when (global+0x98 & (node+0xc0 >> 24) & 7) is set and clears those bits after, and only vtable slot 0x50 (main+0xa4fc68, bfi r1,r3,#24,#3) sets them; the mTextureRect setter (main+0xa4fb58) returns early while the four floats match and tail-calls slot 0x50 on a change. r59, r60 and r61 all wrote +0x10c by hand, so all three drew the band that was there when the quad was first built - yellow 0.0 280.0 88.0 304.0 - the unworn frame at every tier. r62 restores r59's geometry (no shade_window, no SHADE_WINDOW, u = 0..88) and publishes the bar's live four floats through the setter: write_shade calls memory::call2(base() + 0xa4fb58, dim, bar + 0x10c) every frame and build_dim hands the setter the same pointer, so the copy's window is the bar's current tier frame and the mark goes up on the frame the band changes. core::UNWORN_TEXTURE_RECT, core::shade_window and SHADE_WINDOW are deleted, with r60's requirement wording ('the shade always draws the unworn blade'), which had it backwards. 6 tree nodes, 7-word object array, (6 << 4) | 8 = 104 bytes = 13 records, the walk emits exactly 13. 23 host fixtures pass - no fixture is possible for the native cache -; verify PASSED with 33 signature windows. r62 Gameplay NOT RUN.

evidence.static_summary: r62: pinned toolchain build; 23 host fixtures passed; verify.py PASSED with 33 NSO signature windows, a unique hook window, the exact export set, resolved imports only, no MSR in the disassembly, no DT_TEXTREL and a one-file payload. The change is how the copy's atlas window is published: write_shade calls the mTextureRect setter (main+0xa4fb58) with the bar's own live four floats at bar+0x10c every frame, and build_dim hands the setter the same pointer. The setter returns at once while the floats match and, on a change, stores +0x10c, calls slot 0x28 when +0x108 & 0x30, and tail-calls slot 0x50 (main+0xa4fc68) - the only writer of the +0xc0 bits 24..26, which the draw slot main+0xa4fc9c's builder main+0xa4feb4 consumes and clears. The raw writes of r59, r60 and r61 marked nothing, so those three drew the band in +0x10c when the quad was first built (yellow 0.0 280.0 88.0 304.0). r61 is withdrawn unrun and its squeeze premise, and r58's, is refuted: a scissor clips at 1:1 and the orange crops show no spiral inside the dark part at half sharpness. Geometry is r59's: u = 0..88, v = the live band. See EVIDENCE.json, DEVELOPMENT.md and work/modern-sharpness-gauge/PHASE5_RESEARCH.md.
evidence.manual_summary: The accepted r44 cut is one Eden run of 2026-10-30, the installed NRO matching the packaged payload. r45 ran 2026-10-31 as FROZEN_GAME. r46 ran clean with no copy, r47, r48 and r50 logged the copy build and the draw, r51 added the queue, r54 added the mask enter and ran with the copy frozen, r55 logged the link-lost teardown and r56 proved the map overflow. r57 was run on Eden 2026-10-31 with a 7-entry map, the rebuild bit on the clip mask, the copy's transform, quad and rect read back per frame and a box that follows the cut: it was rejected on screen (the copy invisible, the bar's colour bled through, 228 fill lines with no matrix) and its 15-minute log reached the composed state only at 836 s. r59 was accepted on Eden 2026-11-01 for the shade's placement, colour, transform and sampler; its crops showed the shade drawing the yellow frame at every tier. r60 ran the same day, rejected on screen with the dark part unchanged at orange and red; its 73 fill lines all read shade_tex=0.0 280.0 88.0 304.0 while the bar's own tex= played all three bands. r61 was packaged, never run, and is withdrawn with its squeeze premise refuted. r62 published the copy's atlas window through the native setter and is accepted on Eden 2026-11-01: the user's crop of the red tier shows the notched worn blade, and he wrote 'looks correct now'. r62 is the pinned release candidate, bytes frozen. Ryujinx and Switch hardware unconfirmed.
